build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized scene variables
create_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and position
add_standing_sticks: add static or dynamic standingsticks to the PHYRE scene with angle and scale parameters
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to require two bodies to be in a TOUCHING spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to specify the TWO_BALLS solution tier
